riddle_r1_compass.title: The Guiding Needle
riddle_r1_compass.text: I have no voice, but I speak of four lands. I have a single trembling finger that points without hands. In iron or bronze I forever dwell; follow my needle and all shall be well. What nautical instrument am I?

hints.text: A brass navigational instrument containing a magnetic needle pointing North.

riddle_r1_anchor.title: The Iron Sleeper
riddle_r1_anchor.text: Heavy as lead, forged in dark flame; cast me overboard, I stop the grand game. With flukes to the seabed and shank in the tide, until ye haul wind, right here ye abide. What am I?

hints.text: A heavy iron device dropped from the bow to moor a vessel to the seafloor.

riddle_r1_hourglass.title: The Sands of Tide
riddle_r1_hourglass.text: Two glass bells joined at the waist, I swallow fine shore with no sign of haste. Turn me on my head and my journey begins anew; mariners use me to strike the bells true. What timepiece am I?

hints.text: A nautical sand timer with two glass bulbs connected by a narrow neck.

riddle_r1_spyglass.title: The Crow's Eye
riddle_r1_spyglass.text: I stretch out long when brass sleeves slide, pulling far islands right to your side. Closed I am small, open I am tall; through lens of quartz I reveal ships to all. What tool am I?

hints.text: A collapsible handheld refracting telescope used by sailors.

riddle_r1_map.title: Parchment of the Red X
riddle_r1_map.text: I have cities without houses, forests without trees, and rivers without water crossing saltless seas. An inked scarlet 'X' marks where riches lay dead; hold me to candlefire to read what was said. What am I?

hints.text: A navigational chart on parchment showing landmarks and secret locations.

riddle_r1_lighthouse.title: The Stone Sentinel
riddle_r1_lighthouse.text: I stand on jagged crags where wild breakers roar. My single eye burns with flame, peering out from the shore. I wear stripes of white and crimson so bold, warning proud captains of reefs deep and cold. What tower am I?

hints.text: A coastal beacon tower emitting light to guide ships and warn of shoals.

riddle_r1_doubloon.title: The Spanish Sun
riddle_r1_doubloon.text: Stamped with royal crests and hauled from sunken hold, I clink in leather pouches, seven grams of solid gold. Pirates spill rum and duel for my shine; pieces of eight are humble cousins of mine. What coin am I?

hints.text: A historic seven-gram Spanish gold coin.

riddle_r1_cannon.title: The Bronze Dragon
riddle_r1_cannon.text: Feed me black powder and a sphere of cold lead. Pull back my lanyard, and silence is dead. Smoke fills the gun-deck and wooden hulls tear; my roar shakes the ocean and poisons the air. What weapon am I?

hints.text: A heavy muzzle-loading smoothbore artillery piece mounted on a carriage.

riddle_r1_rudder.title: The Silent Sternsman
riddle_r1_rudder.text: Tucked under the transom beneath ocean swell, I obey the wooden wheel's command very well. Turn me hard port or starboard to steer; without my flat blade no safe port can draw near. What ship's part am I?

hints.text: A flat timber attached vertically to the sternpost used for steering.

riddle_r1_crowsnest.title: The Perch of the Mast
riddle_r1_crowsnest.text: High above topsails where cold breezes sting, perched on the mainmast like a bird with no wing. From here sounds the cry when a landfall draws near: 'Land ho!' shouts the sailor with eagle eyes clear. What lookout perch am I?

hints.text: A barrel or platform fitted high up on the masthead for the lookout.
